text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
K.S.Miracle conquered the Swan Stakes. A 
miraculous comeback. Her dazzling speed 
captivated everyone watching.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Within her was not just a sense of duty to 
repay the favor, but a genuine desire to 
give back and convey her heartfelt 
gratitude.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
She wanted to give back a miracle to 
everyone even more. To grant that wish, 
she decided to enter the Mile Championship 
alongside her rivals.
